glance_takeaway: This is a final readout of an A/B test ('Pathways' onboarding redesign, variant B vs current A) at a company called tessel, with trial-to-paid conversion as the primary metric. The headline message: there is no overall winner — overall +0.8pp is not statistically significant (p=0.16) because a strong mobile-web gain (+4.2pp, p<0.0001) is being cancelled out by a real iOS loss (-1.9pp, p=0.027), with Android flat. The recommended action is to ship to mobile-web only, not ship iOS (run a fix experiment instead), and not ship Android; early-week results overstated B due to novelty decay, and the 7-day retention guardrail passed flat.

F1.note: Hero card: '+0.8pp ... 11.4% -> 12.2%'; also subgroup table row Overall.

F2.note: Hero: '95% CI [-0.3, +1.9] . p = 0.16' with 'not significant' tag and 'can't tell, not B won' framing.

F3.note: Table footnote 'Trial starters only (13,249 of 184,204 randomized)'; table n 6,602/6,647; validity card '92,114 vs 92,090 against 50/50'.

F4.note: Power card: '80% power to detect an absolute lift of +1.55pp overall (a = 0.05)'; 'not powered to confirm effects smaller than ~1.5pp'.

F5.note: Forest-plot caption and trust card: 'platform was the single pre-registered subgroup dimension, chosen before launch' — not post-hoc fishing.

F6.note: Table: 13.9% -> 18.1%, +4.2, [+2.1, +6.3], p<0.0001; trust card: 'survives easily' under Bonferroni.

F7.note: Table: 11.6% -> 9.7%, -1.9, [-3.6, -0.2], p 0.027; trust card: 'does not survive the strict correction' but pre-registration + mechanism make it 'a credible signal that warrants action'.

F8.note: Table and forest plot: Android +0.1pp, [-1.7, +1.9], p 0.92, gray/null styling.

F9.note: Headline 'cancelling each other out' plus explicit weighted reconciliation equation '(2,354 x 4.2 - 2,535 x 1.9 + 1,736 x 0.1) / 6,625 ~ +0.8pp' and 'not a modest win everywhere'.

F10.note: Weekly bar chart with exact series +2.9, +1.5, +0.6, 0.0, -0.4, +0.1; hero card '+2.9pp -> +0.1pp week 1 -> week 6' with 'novelty decay' tag.

F11.note: '...but the platform split is not novelty' card: weeks 4-6 pooled 'Mobile-web still +3.8pp', 'iOS still -2.2pp' (flagged exploratory).

F12.note: Guardrail card/table: 31.2% -> 31.4%, +0.2pp [-0.2, +0.6], 'flat — pass'; tickets +12% wks 1-2 'blip, resolved', 0% wks 3-6.

F13.note: Secondaries table: 4m52s -> 4m14s (= 292s -> 254s), -38s [-45, -31], p<0.001; trial-start 7.17% vs 7.22% flat, tied to denominator validity.

F14.note: Step-3 drop-off bars: iOS 8.1% -> 12.7%, mobile-web 3.2% -> 3.4%, Android 5.0% -> 5.6%, with the OS-dialog mechanism explained; bar widths proportional.

F15.note: Decision strip + numbered next steps: ship mobile-web only with 5% holdback, do not ship iOS (ONB-2026-019 reverts/softens prompt), do not ship Android; validity card 'No sample-ratio mismatch ... chi2 p = 0.96', instrumentation audited clean.

render_issues: none material — the hero forest-plot card has some unused vertical whitespace below the chart at desktop width; all SVG geometry checked against labeled values and is proportionally honest
strengths: Perfect fact survival: all 15 facts present with correct numbers, directions, and significance status; the weighted reconciliation equation makes F9 (win and loss averaging out) unusually concrete.

The glance zone alone delivers all four required takeaways: headline states the cancellation, the forest plot color-codes CIs clear of zero vs crossing zero, and the three-card decision strip lands the narrow ship.

Exemplary uncertainty hygiene: Bonferroni discussion cuts both ways, funnel evidence labeled exploratory/confounded and 'not causal on its own', power limitation stated, plan deviation disclosed, and a 'What this readout does not support' section pre-empts the exact misreadings the brief fears.
weaknesses: Long single-scroll page with no table of contents or in-page anchors; finding a specific item again relies on scanning section headings.

Density runs slightly hot for the stated PM audience in places (alpha = 0.0167 threshold, Bayesian-shrinkage plan deviation, per-arm-averaged weights in the reconciliation equation that a careful reader may try to match against the table's per-arm n's).
The novelty-decay takeaway lives in a smaller side card in the glance zone, so at a true 10-second glance it lands less reliably than the other three takeaways.
